diff_batch.description: 2styles x2seeds x4promptarms, plus CFG0/1 on seed37; native CFG2 baselines reused. No trained reward or human labels. Prompts and lyrics newly authored for this experiment.
primary_contrasts: within model/style/seed, base versus literal_zh/literal_en/concrete at nativeCFG2
limitations: Same initial noise is required and hash-checked, but musical phrases may diverge.
Encoder cosine is a diagnostic, not proof of generation compliance.
Prompt assignment is not a human naturalness label; no detection accuracy can be computed from the assignment.
Synth retention and quality must be judged independently.

cases.style: An intimate indie pop song with female lead vocals, 88 BPM, acoustic guitar, piano, warm electric bass, and live drums.
cases.lyrics:
[start]
[verse]
Morning light is falling on the avenue
Every quiet window keeps a shade of blue
I can hear the footsteps turning into song
Carry all the small things as we move along
[chorus]
Stay until the city finds a softer glow
Let the little rivers in the streetlights flow
Keep the rhythm breathing as the hours go
There is something here we do not have to know
[verse]
Silver clouds are drifting where the rooftops meet
Someone leaves a flower by the empty seat
Every passing moment has a place to land
We can make a sunrise with an open hand
[chorus]
Stay until the city finds a softer glow
Let the little rivers in the streetlights flow
Keep the rhythm breathing as the hours go
There is something here we do not have to know
[outro]
